About this Event

DESI Community presents DIWALI GLAM — Where Class Meets Elegance.
Get ready Tri-State — DESI Community is BACK with a banger of a Diwali Party!
Single vibes • Couple tribes • Family & friends.
Friday, November 6, 2026
The Parlor Banquet, 2863 Woodbridge Ave, Edison, NJ 08837
6:30 PM — Shubh Deepawali Puja
7:00 PM — Party starts. Let's glam it up!
WHAT'S ON:
Live DJ — Bollywood & Desi beatsDance performances — DC's Got Talent!Glam photobooth — capture the moments, make memoriesFood & liquor included — Indian bites & moreDRESS CODE: High on tradition. Higher on glamour.
TICKETS:
GA Tickets: $80pp
VIP Tickets: $90pp [Premium seating closer to the dance floor & stage. One champagne bottle and a wine bottle per VIP Table (of 10 seating)]
Kids (6 - 12) — $45 each;
Kids under 5 enter free.
Prices subject to change anytime without prior notice.
For sponsorship & more info, contact DESI Community 609-517-8477.
Tickets also available via Zelle/Venmo: M&M @ 517-488-8779.
